children: Stock markets in the United Arab Emirates rose on Friday after a business survey showed the country's non-oil private sector expanded at a solid pace in August, driven by stronger output and new business growth.
The S&P Global UAE Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 55.3 in August from 52.7 in July.
